Name: Name
tooltip_elapsedInterval: How often will be updated elapsed time for tracks in ms. Do not make it too small to reduce load on system.
tooltip_fadeIn: Fade in interval in ms for speech announcements. 0 - fade in is disabled.
tooltip_fadeOut: Fade out interval in ms for speech announcements. 0 - fade out is disabled.
tooltip_quickstarts: Eight shortcuts for the VIS widget. Click a free button in the widget to save what is playing. Long-press a button to rename, replace or clear it. Click “Load current shortcuts” here before editing, then save. An empty table does not delete widget shortcuts.
